hcmc/Địa đạo Củ Chi.why: The tunnels have two visitor sites 11 km apart; the pin is Bến Dược (the larger one), OpenStreetMap matched Bến Đình. Both are real.

dalat/Nem nướng Bà Hùng.why: The original shop is 328 Phan Đình Phùng, which the pin matches; OpenStreetMap's 'Nem Nuong Ba Hung' is another branch on Trần Phú.

dalat/Mây Lang Thang.why: A touring music show with no fixed venue (only an office address), so a pin would mislead.

hcmc/Chợ ẩm thực Hồ Thị Kỷ.source: data/research/hcmc-explore.json (Chợ hoa Hồ Thị Kỷ, Wanderlog)
hcmc/Chợ ẩm thực Hồ Thị Kỷ.why: The food alley is hẻm 52 Hồ Thị Kỷ, the same lane as the flower market; no page gives the food stalls their own point.

dalat/Dốc Sương Nguyệt Ánh.why: A sloping street, not a venue; the pin is the street's OpenStreetMap point.

mytho/Lăng Hoàng Gia (Gò Công).why: Neither OpenStreetMap nor Wikipedia has the tomb's point; the pin is Gò Công town, where the tomb is. Directions search by name, so they still reach it.

mytho/Công viên Tết Mậu Thân & phố đi bộ.why: OpenStreetMap has the park itself; the research had no coordinates.

nhatrang/Tắm bùn Trăm Trứng (100 Egg).why: The pin is Google's (via Wanderlog) on Nguyễn Tất Thành, Phước Đồng, matching the address; OpenStreetMap's 'Tram Trung 100 egg' on Ngô Tất Tố in town looks like a booking office.

hcmc/Mặn Mòi (Thảo Điền).why: OpenStreetMap matched the other Mặn Mòi branch on Võ Văn Tần (Quận 3); this entry is the Thảo Điền branch.

hcmc/O Phương – Món ngon sông Hương.why: The shop is 162 Điện Biên Phủ at the Trương Quyền corner in Quận 3, which the pin matches; OpenStreetMap matched the other 162 Điện Biên Phủ in Bình Thạnh.

hcmc/Rừng ngập mặn Cần Giờ.why: Pin from Wikipedia; OpenStreetMap's point is the middle of the whole biosphere reserve.

dalat/Vườn dâu Ichigo.why: Google pin (via Wanderlog) for 100 Cam Ly; OpenStreetMap matched only the ward.

nhatrang/Khu du lịch Ba Hồ.why: Same waterfalls as the original research's 'Suối Ba Hồ'; the two pins sit at different points of one site.
